name: api-gateway-mcp-server
description: Configures Google Cloud API Gateway to act as a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server (Public Preview) that exposes REST APIs as agent tools over HTTP (POST /mcp). Use when exposing an API Gateway API as MCP tools, migrating OpenAPI 2.0 specs to OpenAPI 3.x for MCP, annotating specs with x-google-api-management.mcp and x-google-mcp-tool, securing tools/list with JWTs or API keys, connecting Google ADK (McpToolset) or Apigee API hub and Agent Registry, or troubleshooting MCP JSON-RPC errors (-32601, -32602, -32000), /mcp HTTP 404 or 405 errors, and MCP errors from api-configs create. Do not use for a migration without MCP or another OpenAPI error from api-configs create (use api-gateway-openapi-spec-authoring), API key, JWT, or quota setup for REST only (use api-gateway-backend-security-and-rate-limiting), failing non-MCP requests (use api-gateway-troubleshooting), Apigee X proxy bundles, outbound LLM model routing, or GKE Gateway API.
author: google
